invariants.text: Product.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
User.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
When a product is searched by name, only products whose name matches the search term are returned.
When a product is filtered by category, only products belonging to that category are included in the result set.
When a product has a maximum price specified, only products with a price less than or equal to the maximum price are included.
When a product has a minimum quantity specified, only products with a quantity greater than or equal to the minimum quantity are included.
All filters—name, category, maximum price, and minimum quantity—can be combined and applied simultaneously to the product list.
If no filters are applied, all products are returned.
